programme.title: Lola and the Numbers
programme.desc: Lola is a playful little girls who loves numbers! She is constantly on the move and is always ready to count together with her number firends from one to ten. Lola and the Numbers is all about setting that pre-math knowledge for its young viewers. The show helps us to identify different numbers, count from one to ten and develop our pre-math skills. The most important viewing tip is that we always count with Lola! whether in English or your own language, counting along is always fun.

programme.title: Puffy and Tubby
programme.desc: Puffy and Tubby are a couple of adorable little guinea pigs and they are always hungry. Join them as they go on everyday adventures, exploring their environment in an attempt to find more food. Helping young viewers to develop their social skills, experience various different adventures and identify new everyday objects, this show is the perfect combination of education and fun. Make the lessons even more interactive for your little ones by associating the objects identified in the show with those in your home.

programme.title: Zack & Ziggy
programme.desc: This lovely animated children's series explores the basic concepts of size and comparison. It follows the everyday adventures of a little nerdy boy named Zack and his loyal dog best friend, Ziggy. The inseparable pair turn every situation into a chance to learn, including taking a walk, playing sports and getting ready for bed. Join the two sweet friends on their exciting exploration of the world around them.

programme.title: In the Museum
programme.desc: Can you help Mr.Clown find the missing animals? When animals start mysteriously disappearing from some of the paintings in the museum, Mr.Clown must go searching for them so that he can put them back in their correct places. In the Museum is a great introduction to different kinds of art for the littlest viewers, promotes shape recognition and helps young viewers to recognise and identify different types of animals. Importantly you can also use the animals disappearing as a great way to let young viewers know that it is perfectly okay to make mistakes.

programme.title: Ducky and Friends
programme.desc: In Ducky and Friends our little duck is sharing all the fun with her friends, Lola, Henry and Toby. Stories are created with the help of child psychologists and aim to teach toddlers how to play nicely with their friends without arguing and how to adapt during mutual play. They also show that exploring the world with peers brings joy and satisfaction.

programme.title: Happy Kingdom
programme.desc: Happy Kingdom catches up with the adorable bunnies from Happy Meadow and introduces us to new friends like the princess Sari, the brave prince Nati, the caring cook-squirrel, the fearless knight-hedgehog and the resourceful wizard-bear. This fun and colourful show further develops the young viewers ability to recognise and identify animals, reinforces colour identification and is a fun new way of learning. Get creative and host an animal toy party whilst you watch, or mess around and imitate the animal noises. No matter how you decide to interact with this wonderful show, the Happy Kingdom will always be full of fun.

Although they are responsible for the maintenance of the house they also make lots of time to play games and have fun. Taking on the activities of both adults and children helps to start communication between children and parents about responsibility. Margo and Felix encourages creative thinking and lots of fun.

programme.title: Happy Meadow
programme.desc: Two happy rabbits, Sari and Nati have lots of fun playing in Happy Meadow, in this children's cartoon. They have plenty of other lovable friends who also live in Happy Meadow with them. This is a Duck TV production. Duck TV aim to produce content for young children that is educating, and aids their development, while being entertaining at the same time. This show helps children to grow their vocabulary, as they are encouraged to name all of the different animals that they might see playing in the meadow. They also are encouraged to imitate the animal sounds, growing their knowledge even further. The show encourages object recognition, and colour identification, too. All of which is achieved in a fun and creative way.

programme.title: Enlightment Corner
programme.desc: This cartoon, made for young children, is fun and entertaining, but also holds educational benefits. This is a Duck TV production, which aims to aid the development of children, in a fun and engaging way. This particular series will support a child's ability to identify everyday objects that they might encounter in their lives, learn new skills, and develop their thinking and observational skills, too. This programme makes learning fun and easy, so children pick up these skills in an effortless way, and remain engaged throughout. This is great way for children to learn, and a positive attitude towards gaining new skills will serve them well later on in life, too.

programme.title: My Pet Family
programme.desc: Pets are part of the family! In My Pet Family, the preschooler Tony shows us how much joy, love and responsibility comes with owning pets. Molly, the cat and Lucas, the puppy give Tony all their love while they learn, play, eat, bath and share adventures together.Stories are backed by psychological research on how owning a pet is beneficial for children. While enjoying My Pet Family your children will receive support in understanding responsibilities and that animals are to be respected, protected and loved.

programme.desc: This cartoon takes a look into the lives of a range of the cutest baby animals, and explores their family relationships. Everyday, after a big adventure exploring their surroundings, they'll return home to their loving families, to be greeted with lots of love and affection. As is the case with many Duck TV programmes, this programme is designed to both educate and entertain it's young audience. Children will become able to recognise the similar characteristic features of animals, develop social skills, and present emotional bonds, as well as thoroughly enjoying their viewing time.

Duck TV exercise presenters, Langi, Rundi, and Rendi, will guide your child through a simple step by step tutorial, which they can follow along at home. It's fun and easy, and gets kids up on their feet and moving. With all Duck TV productions, there is great educational benefits. This programme will develop a child's cognitive and motor skills, along with their coordination, which is essential to the development of a healthy child.

programme.title: Enchanting Sights
programme.desc: This children's animation displays spinning and spiralling geometric shapes, and is accompanied by the calming sound of soothing music, ideal for a young child. This programme can aid children in learning the names of shapes, giving them a head start in their mathematical development, and spacial awareness. The combination of colour, music, and shapes also aims to nurture the child's ability to be creative and imaginative. This is a programme designed to keep children entertained, but also aid their development, and educate them to a degree, as well.

programme.title: Small – But Hardworking
programme.desc: This cartoon is designed to entertain and educate very young children, by showing three elves building a variety of different objects with materials such as wood and ice. Duck TV aims to produce content that is educational and aid the development of young children. This show effectively advances children's ability to use their imagination, by stimulating their senses with a bright colourful cartoon, and the moving objects only enhances this further. The programme also aids children in beginning to recognise shapes, preparing them for school in doing so.

programme.title: Ducky and Friends
programme.desc: In Ducky and Friends our little duck is sharing all the fun with her friends, Lola, Henry and Toby. Stories are created with the help of child psychologists and aim to teach toddlers how to play nicely with their friends without arguing and how to adapt during mutual play. They also show that exploring the world with peers brings joy and satisfaction.

programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: Sounds Around Us
programme.desc: Liza and Ben the little elf twins love learning about new sounds. Join them in this series of animated shorts to learn more about sounds, how to find them and how to recreate them. Follow them as they whizz away on exciting adventures together to investigate where different familiar sounds are coming from. Play along with the twins and encourage your child to listen and identify the sounds you hear together. See if you and your child can work out where the sound is coming from before the twins do, while having fun recreating the sounds for yourself at home.

programme.title: Color Clara
programme.desc: Clara is an extraordinary, extra colourful, chameleon girl. Deep in the jungle in her cosy chameleon house, Clara uses her colour changing powers for good by helping her wrongly coloured jungles friends and objects to return to their natural colour. Making learning fun again, this exciting jungle tale helps young viewers to connect objects to their usual colours, developing their basic visual skills and introducing them to new and exotic environments such as the jungle.

programme.title: DuckSchool
programme.desc: In a forest kindergarden, woodland animals who call it their home are learning the basics of English from their helpful fairy teacher, Miss Sunshine. Learn some brand new words and practice your counting skills, or listen carefully to the stories Miss Sunshine has to tell. With Duckschool we can learn about how the seasons change, different kinds of weather, the amazing planets in our night sky and so many other things! There might even be some special guests to meet along the way.

programme.title: Henry's Stories
programme.desc: Henry loves telling stories, but he needs your help to make sure it's all in the correct order. Follow Henry in these silent animated shorts as he constructs stories with the help of his handy picture cards. Narrate the sequences together and solve his picture puzzles to see the story come to life. Identify the beginnings and endings of simple everyday stories, while carefully piecing together all of the events in between. Teaches children about cause and effect, while encouraging logical thinking and deductive reasoning.

programme.title: Zack & Ziggy
programme.desc: This lovely animated children's series explores the basic concepts of size and comparison. It follows the everyday adventures of a little nerdy boy named Zack and his loyal dog best friend, Ziggy. The inseparable pair turn every situation into a chance to learn, including taking a walk, playing sports and getting ready for bed. Join the two sweet friends on their exciting exploration of the world around them.

programme.title: Doll Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Join Bell and her friends Fido the Kangaroo and Lilo the Bear as they come to help everyone and anyone in the forest! Incorporating education into enjoyable animations, cartoons and mini-series', Doll Team to the Rescue educates toddlers and children in developing their social skills with others, the importance of friendship, all whilst being able to experience various adventures! The main message within Doll Team to the Rescue is to teach children the love and respect for animals. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. Ducktv which specialises in television for absolute beginners create animations, cartoons and miniseries bring fun alongside entertainment for the smallest TV viewers. Under supervision of child psychologists in order to meet all requirements for babies after 3 months, the characteristics of each episode of their shows with music help children to develop their cognitive capabilities. Available 24 hours and 7 days a week, Ducktv ensures to amuse, develop and relax younger audiences as well as educating them in an enjoyable way.

programme.title: Ducky Adventures
programme.desc: Every day is a different adventure for Ducky! This animated show for very young children lets toddlers and pre-schoolers to join Ducky and learn through daily activities. This series is brought to you by DuckTV, which works with child psychologists in creating programmes for babies and toddlers. Ducky Adventures has been designed to help your child develop their observational skills whilst also letting them use their imagination and creativity. This cartoon can be used as a conversation starter for the little ones in your life: you can talk to toddlers about their thoughts and opinions on the activities you've seen in the programme or the things that happen in your toddler's life.

programme.title: Tempo Giusto
programme.desc: Tempo Giusto is a playful introduction to the understanding of the concept of time. The always cheerful Lola tells the time and together with the great storyteller Henry, they show us what kids do at different parts of the day.

programme.title: Higher the Better
programme.desc: Join Kiteko, the goofy giraffe and Umi, the playful meerkat in Higher the Better, as they observe the everyday life of toddlers and learn from the children about their everyday activities such as picking apples and painting! When they're not helping pick apples with the children, they are going on field trips and making lots of fun whilst they are playing. While watching, focus the attention of the youngster by speaking with them about what the children are drawing or how fast they can run! Combining education and fun, Higher the Better allows the development of social skills for toddlers, encourages them to observe and think deeper about what they are watching on their screen and initiates communication between parent and child, as well as children and their friends! Created by Ducktv, each animation, cartoon and mini-series is created with supervision of child psychologists to meet all the requirements of babies after three months of age. The combination between education, wholesome, amusing and relaxing elements within their shows aid toddlers to develop their visual and auditory abilities. Available 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, parents can be assured that their children can learn all the skills they need in life whilst still doing something fun.

programme.title: ABC – duckBC
programme.desc: Writing skills introduced, explained and developed through the animated adventures of the five stalwarts of the art of penmanship: Pen, Pencil, Stamp, Eraser and Brush. From A to Z, the five friends take children through the steps to produce beautiful letters and write wonderful words.

programme.title: Sunville – Sportsville
programme.desc: All of your favourite Sunville residents join together to participate in one amazing sports day. Mister Goat, the Raccoon Family, Kitty Cat and the Friendly Pig are participating in Sports Day, and they want you to come along and join the fun! This interactive cartoon encourages children to join in and exercise alongside these incredibly cute characters, who can at times be a little competitive, too. In doing so, not only will your child have lots of fun, but they will be exercising and developing basic coordination skills along the way. They will also increase muscle strength and sense of balance, which will benefit them in their everyday lives, and keep them healthy and happy.

programme.title: Margo & Felix
programme.desc: Margo and Felix live in a beautiful little house which they must take care of themselves. Although they are responsible for the maintenance of the house they also make lots of time to play games and have fun. Taking on the activities of both adults and children helps to start communication between children and parents about responsibility. Margo and Felix encourages creative thinking and lots of fun.

programme.title: Happy Meadow
programme.desc: Two happy rabbits, Sari and Nati have lots of fun playing in Happy Meadow, in this children's cartoon. They have plenty of other lovable friends who also live in Happy Meadow with them. This is a Duck TV production. Duck TV aim to produce content for young children that is educating, and aids their development, while being entertaining at the same time. This show helps children to grow their vocabulary, as they are encouraged to name all of the different animals that they might see playing in the meadow. They also are encouraged to imitate the animal sounds, growing their knowledge even further. The show encourages object recognition, and colour identification, too. All of which is achieved in a fun and creative way.

programme.title: Toby McFly
programme.desc: Toby McFly is a pilot dog, who shows us how the world looks from above. He is flying above beautiful nature scenery, animals, people and different places of interest. After admiring the view from above he lands his plane and shows us in detail what he saw from above.

programme.title: Dotty, the Kitty
programme.desc: A super fun and creative show, Dotty the Kitty attempts to connect the dots that the pencil draws to discover the hidden image and paint the final picture. As always with Duck TV this show make education and development exciting and enjoyable for its young viewers. Helping children to connect the dots improves their ability to recognise and identify shapes and objects, develop hand-eye coordination and for the slightly older viewers it improves their association of objects with their realistic shapes and colours. Encouraging the creativity and imagination out of your child, Dotty the Kitty provides endless fun.

programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. programme.title: Tempo Giusto
programme.desc: Tempo Giusto is a playful introduction to the understanding of the concept of time. The always cheerful Lola tells the time and together with the great storyteller Henry, they show us what kids do at different parts of the day.

programme.title: The Way We Travel
programme.desc: This cartoon is designed to aid the development of young children. Your child will watch various vehicles, therefore making them aware of a variety of different shapes and objects in the real world. They will also observe how they operate, which will allow them to grow an understanding of how they may be used in everyday life, as they see their different parts. Additionally, your child will experience the noises that these vehicles make, and be given the opportunity to acquire basic language skills, too. This show will not only keep young children entertained, but it will educate them too, in regards to the outside world.

programme.title: Higher the Better
programme.desc: Join Kiteko, the goofy giraffe and Umi, the playful meerkat in Higher the Better, as they observe the everyday life of toddlers and learn from the children about their everyday activities such as picking apples and painting! When they're not helping pick apples with the children, they are going on field trips and making lots of fun whilst they are playing. While watching, focus the attention of the youngster by speaking with them about what the children are drawing or how fast they can run! Created by Ducktv, each animation, cartoon and mini-series is created with supervision of child psychologists to meet all the requirements of babies after three months of age. This programme can aid children in learning the names of shapes, giving them a head start in their mathematical development, and spacial awareness. The combination of colour, music, and shapes also aims to nurture the child's ability to be creative and imaginative. This is a programme designed to keep children entertained, but also aid their development, and educate them to a degree, as well.

programme.title: Higher the Better
programme.desc: Join Kiteko, the goofy giraffe and Umi, the playful meerkat in Higher the Better, as they observe the everyday life of toddlers and learn from the children about their everyday activities such as picking apples and painting! When they're not helping pick apples with the children, they are going on field trips and making lots of fun whilst they are playing. While watching, focus the attention of the youngster by speaking with them about what the children are drawing or how fast they can run! Combining education and fun, Higher the Better allows the development of social skills for toddlers, encourages them to observe and think deeper about what they are watching on their screen and initiates communication between parent and child, as well as children and their friends! Created by Ducktv, each animation, cartoon and mini-series is created with supervision of child psychologists to meet all the requirements of babies after three months of age. The combination between education, wholesome, amusing and relaxing elements within their shows aid toddlers to develop their visual and auditory abilities. Available 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, parents can be assured that their children can learn all the skills they need in life whilst still doing something fun.

programme.title: Henry's Stories
programme.desc: Henry loves telling stories, but he needs your help to make sure it's all in the correct order. Follow Henry in these silent animated shorts as he constructs stories with the help of his handy picture cards. Narrate the sequences together and solve his picture puzzles to see the story come to life. Identify the beginnings and endings of simple everyday stories, while carefully piecing together all of the events in between. Teaches children about cause and effect, while encouraging logical thinking and deductive reasoning.

programme.title: Ducky and Friends
programme.desc: In Ducky and Friends our little duck is sharing all the fun with her friends, Lola, Henry and Toby. Stories are created with the help of child psychologists and aim to teach toddlers how to play nicely with their friends without arguing and how to adapt during mutual play. They also show that exploring the world with peers brings joy and satisfaction.

programme.title: Margo & Felix
programme.desc: Margo and Felix live in a beautiful little house which they must take care of themselves. Although they are responsible for the maintenance of the house they also make lots of time to play games and have fun. Taking on the activities of both adults and children helps to start communication between children and parents about responsibility. Margo and Felix encourages creative thinking and lots of fun.

programme.title: Doll Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Join Bell and her friends Fido the Kangaroo and Lilo the Bear as they come to help everyone and anyone in the forest! Incorporating education into enjoyable animations, cartoons and mini-series', Doll Team to the Rescue educates toddlers and children in developing their social skills with others, the importance of friendship, all whilst being able to experience various adventures! The main message within Doll Team to the Rescue is to teach children the love and respect for animals. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. programme.title: Puffy and Tubby
programme.desc: Puffy and Tubby are a couple of adorable little guinea pigs and they are always hungry. programme.title: Groups
programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. This show is most beneficial with sufficient interaction with the children that it's aimed at, for example the learning of older children is enhanced by asking them questions such as "what's different" between two or more objects. For younger children it is more beneficial to just point out these differences or similarities. Groups helps to develop young viewers' observational skills, attributing objects into different categories and recognising defining attributes of different objects.

programme.title: Lola and the Numbers
programme.desc: Lola is a playful little girls who loves numbers! She is constantly on the move and is always ready to count together with her number firends from one to ten. Lola and the Numbers is all about setting that pre-math knowledge for its young viewers. The show helps us to identify different numbers, count from one to ten and develop our pre-math skills. programme.title: Ducky Adventures
programme.desc: Every day is a different adventure for Ducky! This animated show for very young children lets toddlers and pre-schoolers to join Ducky and learn through daily activities. This series is brought to you by DuckTV, which works with child psychologists in creating programmes for babies and toddlers. Ducky Adventures has been designed to help your child develop their observational skills whilst also letting them use their imagination and creativity. This cartoon can be used as a conversation starter for the little ones in your life: you can talk to toddlers about their thoughts and opinions on the activities you've seen in the programme or the things that happen in your toddler's life.

programme.title: Sounds Around Us
programme.desc: Liza and Ben the little elf twins love learning about new sounds. Join them in this series of animated shorts to learn more about sounds, how to find them and how to recreate them. Follow them as they whizz away on exciting adventures together to investigate where different familiar sounds are coming from. Play along with the twins and encourage your child to listen and identify the sounds you hear together. See if you and your child can work out where the sound is coming from before the twins do, while having fun recreating the sounds for yourself at home.

programme.title: Margo & Felix
programme.desc: Margo and Felix live in a beautiful little house which they must take care of themselves. Although they are responsible for the maintenance of the house they also make lots of time to play games and have fun. Taking on the activities of both adults and children helps to start communication between children and parents about responsibility. Margo and Felix encourages creative thinking and lots of fun.

programme.title: DuckSchool
programme.desc: In a forest kindergarden, woodland animals who call it their home are learning the basics of English from their helpful fairy teacher, Miss Sunshine. Learn some brand new words and practice your counting skills, or listen carefully to the stories Miss Sunshine has to tell. With Duckschool we can learn about how the seasons change, different kinds of weather, the amazing planets in our night sky and so many other things! There might even be some special guests to meet along the way.

programme.title: Henry's Stories
programme.desc: Henry loves telling stories, but he needs your help to make sure it's all in the correct order. Follow Henry in these silent animated shorts as he constructs stories with the help of his handy picture cards. Narrate the sequences together and solve his picture puzzles to see the story come to life. Identify the beginnings and endings of simple everyday stories, while carefully piecing together all of the events in between. Teaches children about cause and effect, while encouraging logical thinking and deductive reasoning.

programme.title: Ducky and Friends
programme.desc: In Ducky and Friends our little duck is sharing all the fun with her friends, Lola, Henry and Toby. Stories are created with the help of child psychologists and aim to teach toddlers how to play nicely with their friends without arguing and how to adapt during mutual play. They also show that exploring the world with peers brings joy and satisfaction.

programme.title: Doll Team to the Rescue
programme.desc: Join Bell and her friends Fido the Kangaroo and Lilo the Bear as they come to help everyone and anyone in the forest! Incorporating education into enjoyable animations, cartoons and mini-series', Doll Team to the Rescue educates toddlers and children in developing their social skills with others, the importance of friendship, all whilst being able to experience various adventures! The main message within Doll Team to the Rescue is to teach children the love and respect for animals. Ducktv recommend that parents, in order to teach the importance of taking care of people as well as respecting animals, should take them to an animal shelter and explain the necessity of protecting and rescuing animals. Ducktv which specialises in television for absolute beginners create animations, cartoons and miniseries bring fun alongside entertainment for the smallest TV viewers. Under supervision of child psychologists in order to meet all requirements for babies after 3 months, the characteristics of each episode of their shows with music help children to develop their cognitive capabilities. Available 24 hours and 7 days a week, Ducktv ensures to amuse, develop and relax younger audiences as well as educating them in an enjoyable way.

programme.title: Cubie
programme.desc: Animated children's series following Cubie the builder who has fantastic plans for new buildings. Cubie loves to build and, with help from his friends, the cheerful cubes, erects inventive new constructions. With Cubie at the helm, the cubes know exactly what to do, and if they encounter a problem, Cubie is always there to help. This enjoyable series from Duck TV helps children build their spatial awareness and observational skills while learning about new prepositions and the basics of building.

programme.title: Didy Baby
programme.desc: Didy Baby is a collection of fun and touching stories all about a group of adorable baby animals. The main theme of this heartwarming yet educational show is the idea of helping each other and working together. It aims to improve its young viewers social skills, develop their observational and thinking skills whilst introducing them to the concept of problem solving and decision making. The show consists of lots of simple situations and stories that encourage creative thinking and widen children's awareness. As an added bonus, problem solving and story telling with your child will help to tighten your relationship.

programme.title: Happy Meadow
programme.desc: Two happy rabbits, Sari and Nati have lots of fun playing in Happy Meadow, in this children's cartoon. Duck TV aim to produce content for young children that is educating, and aids their development, while being entertaining at the same time. This show helps children to grow their vocabulary, as they are encouraged to name all of the different animals that they might see playing in the meadow. They also are encouraged to imitate the animal sounds, growing their knowledge even further. The show encourages object recognition, and colour identification, too. programme.title: Leon-ART
programme.desc: Duck tv has a strong educational aspect. Each series stimulates imagination and creativity thanks to fun characters, colorful graphics, and attention-getting rhythms to entertain the little viewers. Join Leon, the bear as he draws and paints friends for himself to play with. What are his painted friends today? The bear helps to encourage imagination and develop basic visual and motor skills. A whole family can paint together for the perfect bonding activity of parents and children.

programme.title: Ristorante
programme.desc: Welcome to the Ristorante, come in and find out all about how the restaurant works. Learn about all the different processes starting with the preparation and moving to the baking or the cooking, the serving and finally to the dish washing. Encourage your little ones to play pretend, cooking up some imaginary treats for you, your friends and family. Come along to Ristorante and you're sure to build up your vocabulary, whilst improving your ability to identify basic objects and their characteristics, and of course having fun.

programme.title: Puffy and Tubby
programme.desc: Puffy and Tubby are a couple of adorable little guinea pigs and they are always hungry. Join them as they go on everyday adventures, exploring their environment in an attempt to find more food. Helping young viewers to develop their social skills, experience various different adventures and identify new everyday objects, this show is the perfect combination of education and fun. Make the lessons even more interactive for your little ones by associating the objects identified in the show with those in your home.

programme.title: Lola and the Numbers
programme.desc: Lola is a playful little girls who loves numbers! She is constantly on the move and is always ready to count together with her number firends from one to ten. Lola and the Numbers is all about setting that pre-math knowledge for its young viewers. The show helps us to identify different numbers, count from one to ten and develop our pre-math skills. The most important viewing tip is that we always count with Lola! whether in English or your own language, counting along is always fun.

programme.title: Enchanting Sights
programme.desc: This children's animation displays spinning and spiralling geometric shapes, and is accompanied by the calming sound of soothing music, ideal for a young child. This programme can aid children in learning the names of shapes, giving them a head start in their mathematical development, and spacial awareness. The combination of colour, music, and shapes also aims to nurture the child's ability to be creative and imaginative. This is a programme designed to keep children entertained, but also aid their development, and educate them to a degree, as well.

programme.title: Ducky and Friends
programme.desc: In Ducky and Friends our little duck is sharing all the fun with her friends, Lola, Henry and Toby. Stories are created with the help of child psychologists and aim to teach toddlers how to play nicely with their friends without arguing and how to adapt during mutual play. They also show that exploring the world with peers brings joy and satisfaction.

programme.desc: Learning to categorise objects is so much easier with the help of the friendly baby fox in Groups. This show is most beneficial with sufficient interaction with the children that it's aimed at, for example the learning of older children is enhanced by asking them questions such as "what's different" between two or more objects. For younger children it is more beneficial to just point out these differences or similarities. Groups helps to develop young viewers' observational skills, attributing objects into different categories and recognising defining attributes of different objects.

programme.title: Color Clara
programme.desc: Clara is an extraordinary, extra colourful, chameleon girl. Deep in the jungle in her cosy chameleon house, Clara uses her colour changing powers for good by helping her wrongly coloured jungles friends and objects to return to their natural colour. Making learning fun again, this exciting jungle tale helps young viewers to connect objects to their usual colours, developing their basic visual skills and introducing them to new and exotic environments such as the jungle.

programme.title: Higher the Better
programme.desc: Join Kiteko, the goofy giraffe and Umi, the playful meerkat in Higher the Better, as they observe the everyday life of toddlers and learn from the children about their everyday activities such as picking apples and painting! When they're not helping pick apples with the children, they are going on field trips and making lots of fun whilst they are playing. While watching, focus the attention of the youngster by speaking with them about what the children are drawing or how fast they can run! Combining education and fun, Higher the Better allows the development of social skills for toddlers, encourages them to observe and think deeper about what they are watching on their screen and initiates communication between parent and child, as well as children and their friends! Created by Ducktv, each animation, cartoon and mini-series is created with supervision of child psychologists to meet all the requirements of babies after three months of age. The combination between education, wholesome, amusing and relaxing elements within their shows aid toddlers to develop their visual and auditory abilities. Available 24 hours a day and 7 days a week, parents can be assured that their children can learn all the skills they need in life whilst still doing something fun.

programme.title: In the Museum
programme.desc: Can you help Mr.Clown find the missing animals? When animals start mysteriously disappearing from some of the paintings in the museum, Mr.Clown must go searching for them so that he can put them back in their correct places. In the Museum is a great introduction to different kinds of art for the littlest viewers, promotes shape recognition and helps young viewers to recognise and identify different types of animals. Importantly you can also use the animals disappearing as a great way to let young viewers know that it is perfectly okay to make mistakes.

programme.title: Steel Buddies - Stahlharte Geschäfte
programme.desc: Michael Manousakis leitet das Gebrauchtwarenunternehmen Morlock Motors. In seiner Werkstatt bringen er und sein Team tonnenschwere Vehikel wieder auf Vordermann, um die ausrangierten Kolosse mit Profit weiterzuverkaufen. Was sein Unternehmen von der Konkurrenz unterscheidet: Er hat einen Exklusivvertrag mit der US Army. \n\nAuf dem Firmengelände im Westerwald hat sich im Laufe der Jahre ein riesiger Fundus an militärischer Ausrüstung angesammelt, den Manousakis an die Frau oder den Mann bringen will. Unterstützt wird der Inhaber und Geschäftsführer von Werkstattleiter Ingo Meier, Chefmechanikerin Rosi Kötting-Drescher, Lackierer Günter Zschimmer. Doch das Team wächst stetig, um dem riesigen Berg an Aufträgen gerecht zu werden.

In seiner Werkstatt bringen er und sein Team tonnenschwere Vehikel wieder auf Vordermann, um die ausrangierten Kolosse mit Profit weiterzuverkaufen. Was sein Unternehmen von der Konkurrenz unterscheidet: Er hat einen Exklusivvertrag mit der US Army. \n\nAuf dem Firmengelände im Westerwald hat sich im Laufe der Jahre ein riesiger Fundus an militärischer Ausrüstung angesammelt, den Manousakis an die Frau oder den Mann bringen will. Unterstützt wird der Inhaber und Geschäftsführer von Werkstattleiter Ingo Meier, Chefmechanikerin Rosi Kötting-Drescher, Lackierer Günter Zschimmer. Doch das Team wächst stetig, um dem riesigen Berg an Aufträgen gerecht zu werden.

programme.title: Magnum
programme.desc:
Infos zur Serie:

Die Serie handelt von dem Privatdetektiv Thomas Magnum, der auf Hawaii in einem Gästehaus auf dem pompösen Anwesen des Schriftstellers Robin Masters lebt. Magnum arbeitet dort als Sicherheitschef ohne Gehalt, dafür kann er gratis im Gästehaus wohnen und den roten Ferrari benutzen. Das Leben von Magnum wäre so schön, wenn der Verwalter Higgins ihn nicht immer wieder in seine Grenzen weisen würde.

Die amerikanische Krimiserie „Magnum“ wurde in den 80er Jahren auf Hawaii gedreht. Es wurden acht Staffeln mit insgesamt 162 Episoden produziert. 1985 wurde Tom Selleck als bester Serien-Hauptdarsteller mit dem Golden Globe ausgezeichnet.

programme.title: MacGyver
programme.desc: Angus MacGyver, genannt Mac, ist smart, clever und ein Technik-Genie: Ihm genügen die einfachsten Mittel, um Bomben zu entschärfen, einen Fallschirm zu basteln oder einen Handflächenscanner zu überlisten. Daher steht er in Diensten einer Geheimorganisation, die für die USA weltweit brenzlige Situationen löst und üble Gangster ausschaltet. MacGyver und sein Team gehen dabei an ihre Grenzen - schließlich geht es jedes Mal um die Rettung der Welt.

programme.title: FBI: Special Crime Unit
programme.desc: Die harten Fälle landen bei ihr: FBI-Agentin Maggie Bell (Missy Peregrym) muss den Mord an einer jungen Frau aufklären. Die feierte zuletzt auf einer Luxusjacht mit der Macht-Elite. Der Grund: Die kanadische Schauspielerin wurde 2022 zum zweiten Mal Mutter.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc: Chris Coleman wurde angegriffen, daraus entstand eine Rangelei. programme.title: Castle

programme.sub-title: In guten wie in schlechten Zeiten
programme.desc: Endlich steht der große Tag bevor - doch eine recht hohe Hürde gilt es noch zu überwinden: Beckett ist verheiratet! Vor 15 Jahren ehelichte sie im Suff ihren damaligen Freund Rogan O'Leary in Las Vegas. programme.title: Castle
programme.desc:
Die 6. Staffel endete mit einem Schock … 

Nachdem sich nun herausstellt, dass Castle nicht im Autowrack war, beginnt eine fieberhafte Suche nach dem Krimiautor. Selbst als Beckett ihn findet, bleiben Fragen offen …

Eine Hochzeit, die Rückkehr des Dreifachmörders Jerry Tyson und eine Amnesie von Autor/Detektiv Castle (Nathan Fillion) sind die großen Themen der siebten und vorletzten Staffel, die weiter leichtfüßig und unterhaltsam bleibt.

programme.title: Bull
programme.desc:
Infos zur Serie:

Jason Bull (Michael Weatherly) ist der wichtigste Schlüssel, um Gerichtsverfahren zu gewinnen. Nicht weil er so brillant argumentiert oder ein Näschen für die fehlenden Beweise hat. Bull und sein Team (ein Stylist, eine Psychologin, ein Anwalt, eine Programmiererin und ein Ermittler) können perfekt Menschen lesen und so eine Gruppe Geschworener zusammenstellen, die den eigenen Klienten positiv gesinnt und/oder leicht manipulierbar sind. Kurz: Sie können das Unvorhersehbare vorhersehbar machen. 

Hauptdarsteller Weatherly avancierte durch „Navy CIS“, wo er 13 Staffeln lang Anthony „Tony“ DiNozzo verkörperte, zum absoluten Publikumsliebling und hat eine riesige Fangemeinde, die ihm überallhin folgt. „Bull“ basiert lose auf dem Leben des in den USA extrem populären TV-Psychologen Dr. Phil McGraw, der 1990 mit seiner Firma Courtroom Sciences Inc. – CSI (!) – in eine Marktlücke stieß. Mehr als 20 Millionen Amerikaner:innen sahen die Pilotfolge, und die erste Staffel wurde aus dem Stand zur dritterfolgreichsten Serie nach „The Big Bang Theory“ und „Navy CIS“.

programme.title: Abenteuer Leben täglich
programme.desc: Das Wissensmagazin liefert die tägliche Dosis Verstand, Service und Information mit echtem Aha-Effekt: Ob faszinierende Technik-Gadgets, DIY-Projekte, Reise-Reportagen oder verblüffende Alltagsmythen – das Moderationsteam rund um Tommy Scheel, Seraphina Kalze und Madita van Hülsen beantwortet komplexe Fragen unterhaltsam, verständlich und nah am Leben.

programme.title: Mein Lokal, Dein Lokal - Der Profi kommt
programme.desc:
Infos zur Reihe:

In einer Woche treten jeweils fünf Wirte gegeneinander an. Die Konkurrenten bewerten dabei natürlich das Essen, aber auch den Service, die Atmosphäre, die Sauberkeit, das Gesamtkonzept und das nicht zu definierende „gewisse Etwas“! Mit dabei ist Spitzenkoch Mike Süsser, der die Teilnehmer der Woche besucht, den Wettstreit kommentiert und am Finaltag Punkte vergibt.
Verschiedene Experten testen vorab die Restaurants und Kochkünste und kommentieren die gegenseitigen Besuche in den Gaststätten.

programme.title: Achtung Kontrolle! Wir kümmern uns drum
programme.sub-title: Thema u.a.: Food-Expertin Missy - Auf der Suche nach dem besten Senfrostbraten
programme.desc: Ob ein Einsatz bei einem schweren Unfall, ein Nachbarschaftsstreit oder der Alltag an der Polizeiakademie: Das „Achtung-Kontrolle!“-Team ist mit Bodycams und 360-Grad-Kameras hautnah dabei. \n\nDie Reportagereihe gewährt spannende Einblicke in den Berufsalltag begleitet diese bei Streifen, Kontrollen und Einsätzen.

programme.title: Manta, Manta
programme.desc: Bertie (damals ganz frisch aus der „Lindenstraße“: Til Schweiger) ist leidenschaftlicher Manta-Fahrer. Er hat eine starke Clique und mit Friseuse Uschi (Tina Ruland) eine heiße Blondine an seiner Seite. Dumm ist nur, dass sie ihn grade vor die Tür gesetzt hat. Und als Bertie mit seinem Opel zum Rennen gegen den blasierten Benz-Fahrer Axel antreten will, macht auch noch sein geliebter Bolide schlapp… \n\nWettrennen auch an den Kinokassen: Zwei Wochen vor Wolfgang Bülds Komödie brachte Peter Timm seine Version des PS-Kohlenpott-Mythos auf die Leinwand: „Manta – Der Film“ siegte beim Qualitäts-TÜV und ließ den Rivalen klar hinter sich.

programme.title: Hot Shots! Die Mutter aller Filme
programme.desc: Der Job: im Nahen Osten einen miesen Diktator beseitigen. Der beste Mann für diesen Job: Ex-Pilot Topper (Charlie Sheen), König der Flachpfeifen. Zusammen mit der Eliteeinheit „Müdes Wiesel“ soll er im Auftrag der Air Force für klare Verhältnisse im Orient sorgen. Chef dieser Truppe aus Blinden und Lahmen ist Admiral Benson (Lloyd Bridges). Der hält einen besonderen Rekord: Bei jedem einzelnen seiner bisher 194 Einsätze wurde er abgeschossen…\n\nNach dem „Nackte Kanone“-Strickmuster verulkt Klamaukprofi Jim Abrahams große Kinohits wie „Der mit dem Wolf tanzt“, „Rocky“, „Superman“ und „Ein Offizier und Gentleman“. Gnadenlos hat er dabei vor allem den Tom-Cruise-Kassenknüller „Top Gun“ (1986) ins Visier genommen: Die Klischees des heroischen Fliegerfilms bürstet er gepflegt gegen den Strich. Im Jahr 1993 folgte dann der gelungene zweite Streich: „Hot Shots! Der 2. Versuch“.

programme.title: Twins - Zwillinge
programme.desc:
In den Fünfzigerjahren mischen Forscher einen Cocktail aus den Erban-lagen von sechs außergewöhnlichen Männern und kombinieren ihn mit der Eizelle einer blonden Schönheit. Das Ergebnis ist Julius (Arnold Schwarzenegger) – groß, stark, gut aussehend, gütig und naiv. 

Erst mit 35 erfährt er, dass er einen Zwillingsbruder hat. Vincent (Danny DeVito) – klein, dick, garstig – wurde aus dem Rest der Samenspende zusammengesetzt. Gemeinsam machen sich die ungleichen Brüder auf die turbulente Suche nach ihrer Mutter…

Ob Arnie wie der perfekte Mensch aussieht, sei mal dahingestellt. Als liebenswert weltfremder Supermann ist er jedenfalls hinreißend komisch. Sein Zusammenspiel mit DeVito lief so gut, dass Ivan Reitman die beiden auch für seine Komödie „Junior“ (1994) verpflichtete. Schade nur, dass in der deutschen Fassung einiges vom Wortwitz des Originals verloren gegangen ist.

programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
programme.desc:
Joachim Kroll, geboren 1933 in Oberschlesien, wächst in bitterarmen, traumatischen Verhältnissen auf – als Außenseiter in der Familie, in der Schule und in der Hitlerjugend.

Nach dem Tod seiner Mutter 1955 beginnt er eine 21 Jahre andauernde Mordserie im Ruhrgebiet, der mindestens 14 Menschen zum Opfer fallen. Er erwürgt seine Opfer, vergewaltigt und verstümmelt sie und entwickelt dabei kannibalistische Neigungen.

Sein unauffälliges Auftreten schützt ihn jahrzehntelang vor Entdeckung, während unschuldige Männer für seine Taten beschuldigt werden – einige nehmen sich das Leben.

Erst 1976, als er die vierjährige Marion Ketter aus seiner eigenen Nachbarschaft entführt, tötet und teilweise verzehrt, wird er gefasst. In seiner Wohnung finden Ermittler Körperteile des Kindes. Kroll gesteht bereitwillig und führt die Polizei zu Tatorten.

1982 wird er wegen acht Morden zu lebenslanger Haft verurteilt. Am 1. Juli 1991 stirbt er im Gefängnis an einem Herzinfarkt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
programme.desc:
Ed Gein wächst im US-Bundesstaat Wisconsin unter dem dominanten Einfluss seiner religiös fanatischen Mutter Augusta auf, die ihn und seinen Bruder Henry vollständig von der Außenwelt isoliert.

Nach dem Tod seines Bruders – möglicherweise durch Eds Hand – und dem Tod seiner Mutter 1945 verliert der emotional auf dem Stand eines Kindes gebliebene Ed jegliche moralische Kontrolle.

Zwischen 1947 und 1957 schändet er Frauengräber auf dem örtlichen Friedhof und verarbeitet Leichenteile zu Möbeln, Kleidung und Gebrauchsgegenständen. Er ermordet die Wirtin Mary Hogan 1954 und die Eisenwarenhändlerin Bernice Warden 1957.

Als die Polizei sein Farmhaus durchsucht, entdeckt sie ein groteskes Horrorkabinett aus menschlichen Überresten. Gein gesteht die Morde, wird für verhandlungsunfähig erklärt und in eine psychiatrische Anstalt eingewiesen.

1968 verurteilt, verbringt er den Rest seines Lebens in psychiatrischer Haft und stirbt 1984. Seine Verbrechen inspirierten Werke wie „Psycho“ und „Das Schweigen der Lämmer“. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
programme.sub-title: Fritz Honka – Der \"Frauenmörer von St. Pauli\"
programme.desc:
Am 17. Juli 1975 entdecken Feuerwehrleute nach einem Wohnungsbrand in Hamburg-Ottensen im Dachgeschoss eines Wohnhauses die zerstückelten Leichen von vier Frauen.

Der Mieter Fritz Honka, ein 39-jähriger Nachtwächter mit einer von Vernachlässigung, Armut und Alkoholismus geprägten Biografie, wird noch am selben Tag festgenommen.

Honka hatte seine Opfer – allesamt ältere, sozial marginalisierte Prostituierte aus dem Milieu rund um die Reeperbahn – zwischen 1971 und 1974 erwürgt, zerstückelt und in seiner Wohnung versteckt.

Die Identifizierung der Opfer Gertraud Breuer, Anna Beuschel, Ruth Schuldt und Frida Rohbeck gelingt den Ermittlern mühsam über Kleidungsstücke und Zeugenbefragungen.

Im Prozess 1976 wird Honka wegen verminderter Schuldfähigkeit zu 15 Jahren psychiatrischer Unterbringung verurteilt. 1993 entlassen, stirbt er 1998 unter falschem Namen in einem Pflegeheim. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Anwälte der Toten – Die schlimmsten Serienkiller der Welt
programme.desc:
Im April 1991 erschüttert eine mysteriöse Todesserie die Kinderstation des Grantham und Stephen Krankenhauses in Lincolnshire: Vier Kinder sterben, ein Dutzend erkrankt lebensbedrohlich.

Hinter den Vorfällen steckt die 22-jährige Kinderkrankenschwester Beverly Elliot, die ihren Patienten heimlich tödliche Insulindosen injiziert. Ermittler entdecken extreme Insulinwerte im Blut der Opfer, einen verschwundenen Kühlschranksschlüssel sowie ein gestohlenes Zuteilungsbuch, das Elliot bei jedem Vorfall am Krankenbett belegt.

Psychologen diagnostizieren das Münchhausen-by-Proxy-Syndrom: Elliot suchte Aufmerksamkeit und Bewunderung, indem sie Kinder in Lebensgefahr brachte und sich als aufopferungsvolle Pflegerin inszenierte.

Im Mai 1991 festgenommen, wird sie im November erneut verhaftet. Im Prozess 1993 plädiert sie auf nicht schuldig, wird jedoch in 13 Fällen verurteilt und zu 13 Mal lebenslänglich verurteilt.

Anschließend wird sie in die psychiatrische Hochsicherheitsklinik Rampton verlegt, wo sie 1994 neun der Taten teilweise gesteht. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: ntv Startup
programme.sub-title: Thema u.a.: Bits & Pretzels, Gründerinnen und Stiftungen
programme.desc:
Auf der Münchner Gründerkonferenz Bits & Pretzels präsentieren über 7.500 Gründer und Investoren ihre Ideen.

Das Start-up Karus setzt KI ein, um Waldbrände aus der Luft präziser zu bekämpfen, während der 17-jährige Samuel Hirschhuber mit Tofuton Travel eine Reiseplattform mit Gratis-Übernachtungsmodell für Kurzentschlossene aufbaut.

Ein weiterer Schwerpunkt liegt auf der Female Economy: Gründerinnen kämpfen gegen Unterrepräsentation, da 2025 nur 35 % aller Neugründungen von Frauen stammten und lediglich 1 % des Venture Capitals an rein weibliche Teams floss. Eine neue Plattform vernetzt Unternehmerinnen und schafft Cashback-basierte Investitionsanreize.

Felix Oldenburg revolutioniert mit seiner digitalen Stiftungsplattform das Spenden- und Stiftungswesen, indem er Privatpersonen ermöglicht, in fünf Minuten per Smartphone eine steuerlich absetzbare Stiftung ohne Mindestkapital zu gründen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Secret! Die geheimsten Orte der Welt
programme.desc:
Die National Security Agency ist der mächtigste – und am wenigsten verstandene – Geheimdienst der Welt.

Das Geschehen in ihrem Hauptquartier ist eines der bestgehüteten Geheimnisse der Neuzeit. Doch Fort Meade ist nur die sichtbare Spitze eines globalen Geheimdienstnetzwerks.

Diese Folge enthüllt ein weltweites System aus Abhörstationen und Datenknotenpunkten, das ein Überwachungsnetz bildet, das Kontinente und Ozeane überspannt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Secret! Die geheimsten Orte der Welt
programme.desc:
Nur wenige wissenschaftliche Einrichtungen haben so viel Aufmerksamkeit – oder kritische Beobachtung – auf sich gezogen wie das Institut für Virologie Wuhan.

Das Institut beherbergt Chinas einziges Labor der Biosicherheitsstufe 4 (BSL-4) und wurde errichtet, um die gefährlichsten Krankheitserreger der Welt unter strengsten Sicherheitsvorkehrungen zu erforschen.

Was jedoch in seinen Labors vor sich geht, bleibt der Außenwelt weitgehend verborgen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: stern Investigativ
programme.desc: Ein Team aus Journalistinnen und Journalisten geht undercover vor, um russische Spionage- und Sabotageoperationen in Deutschland aufzudecken. Über gefälschte Identitäten nehmen sie Kontakt zu einem russischen Netzwerk auf, das sogenannte Wegwerfagenten rekrutiert – ungeschulte Personen, die für Kleingeld Spionage-, Sabotage- und Desinformationsaufträge ausführen. Die Recherche enthüllt ein breites Spektrum russischer Angriffsmethoden: von Hackerangriffen auf kritische Infrastruktur über Desinformationskampagnen auf TikTok bis hin zu Mordplänen gegen den bayerischen Drohnenunternehmer Stefan Thumann, der Waffen an die Ukraine liefert. Als die Journalistin Angelique in Soest in eine Falle gelockt und per Morddrohung eingeschüchtert wird, endet die Undercover-Recherche. Die Auswertung von Bitcoin-Transaktionen belegt Verbindungen zu russischen staatlichen Stellen. Experten warnen, Deutschland sei auf diese hybride Kriegsführung unzureichend vorbereitet. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Polizeirevier 53 – Deutschlands härteste Wache
programme.desc: Im März 2023 wurde die umstrittene Polizeiwache 53 im Herzen des sozialen Brennpunkts Kottbusser Tor, auch als "Kotti" bekannt, eröffnet. Armut, Drogen und Gewalt prägen hier den Alltag. Der Ausnahmezustand ist an diesem Ort längst zur Normalität geworden. Das Absurde: während die Mieten rasant steigen, finden vor den Türen Flohmärkte für das allernötigste statt und Kinder spielen zwischen Heroinsüchtigen, die selbst tagsüber mit einer Spritze im Arm wie Zombies durch die Seitenstraßen wanken. Fast scheint es, als wirke der Kotti wie ein Magnet auf Süchtige. Hunderte wenn nicht mehr sind hier allgegenwärtig. Wer hier strandet, flieht dabei oft vor Gewalt und Übergriffen und nutzt das große Angebot unterschiedlichster Drogen, um zu vergessen. Ein Teufelskreis, denn gerade am Kotti ist sexualisierte Gewalt gegen Frauen wie Männer auf einem brutalen Level, wie nur an wenigen Orten in Deutschland. Aber auch Taschendiebstähle und eine weite Palette von kriminellen Übergriffen auf Privateigentum und Bürger, gehören hier ganz selbstverständlich zum Alltag. Zeitgleich schwärmen Touristen über den Platz. Denn für sie ist der Berliner Kotti ein angesagter Party-Hotspot. Es gibt viel zu tun für die wohl härteste Polizeiwache Deutschland's. Dabei geraten vor allem die Dealer ins Visier der Polizei. Doch in der Tunnelwelt des U-Bahnhofs bekommt man die nur schwer fassen. Hinzu kommt, dass hier sind unterschiedlichste Gangs in Konkurrenz um die Abnehmer sind. Und: viele Dealer sind inzwischen selbst schwerst drogenabhängig und damit völlig unberechenbar. Ein Porträt des bunten Lebens am Kotti und begleitet die Einsatzkräfte von der einfachen Straßenkontrolle bis zur höchsten Alarmstufe, als plötzlich eine Waffe im U-Bahnhof gezogen wird. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Kriminelle im Visier – Mit Zielfahndern auf Verbrecherjagd
programme.desc: Mit Zielfahndern auf Verbrecherjagd – gefragt sind hier sehr erfahrene Ermittlerinnen und Ermittler mit Menschenkenntnis, einem gewissen Jagdinstinkt und großer Geduld um auf den richtigen Moment warten können. Wir begleiten Spurensuche, Festnahme und Rückführungen von Straftätern. – Wir begleiten eine der erfahrensten und erfolgreichsten Zielfahndungseinheiten Deutschlands vom LKA Thüringen bei Ihrer Arbeit. Für eine Reportage sind sie bereit mehrfach Einblicke in die verschiedenen Aspekte ihrer Arbeit zu gewähren. Wir sprechen über alte, auch kuriose Fälle und Ausbrecher aus Gefängnissen, schweren anderen Straftätern und über aktuelle Öffentlichkeitsfahndungen. Wir sind bei Vorbesprechungen und Trainings dabei, wie gehen sie vor? – Der Leiter der Einheit wird mit uns offen sprechen. Er ist der Dienstältester Zielfahnder Deutschlands und ein echter Typ. Bei allem liegt es in der Natur der Sache, dass manche Taktik nicht verraten wird. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Bandenkrieg in der Hauptstadt – Schüsse auf Berlins Straßen
programme.desc: In Berlin häufen sich Schusswaffenangriffe auf Wohnhäuser, Autos und Geschäfte, hinter denen organisierte Schutzgelderpressung steckt. Werkstattbesitzer Adem Isbirln schildert, wie sein Partner zur Zahlung von 250.000 Euro erpresst wurde, begleitet von einem Video eines Schussangriffs auf die Werkstatt. Als Isbirln die Sache selbst in die Hand nimmt, gerät er in einen Hinterhalt und entkommt knapp. Als Reaktion auf die eskalierte Gewalt gründet die Berliner Polizei die Sondereinheit Ferrum, die mit Razzien, Zoll und Steuerfahndung die kriminelle Szene unter Druck setzt. Als möglicher Auslöser des Machtvakuums gilt der Tod des kurdischen Paten Kaplan Kieran; seitdem drängen türkische Banden aus Istanbul nach Berlin. Am 13. Mai werden bei einem koordinierten Großeinsatz an 28 Orten fünf Haftbefehle vollstreckt, Schusswaffen und Beweismittel sichergestellt sowie Verdächtige wegen Bildung einer kriminellen Vereinigung dem Ermittlungsrichter vorgeführt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Secret! Die geheimsten Orte der Welt
programme.desc: Die National Security Agency ist der mächtigste – und am wenigsten verstandene – Geheimdienst der Welt. Das Geschehen in ihrem Hauptquartier ist eines der bestgehüteten Geheimnisse der Neuzeit. Doch Fort Meade ist nur die sichtbare Spitze eines globalen Geheimdienstnetzwerks. Diese Folge enthüllt ein weltweites System aus Abhörstationen und Datenknotenpunkten, das ein Überwachungsnetz bildet, das Kontinente und Ozeane überspannt. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Top Secret! Die geheimsten Orte der Welt
programme.desc: Nur wenige wissenschaftliche Einrichtungen haben so viel Aufmerksamkeit – oder kritische Beobachtung – auf sich gezogen wie das Institut für Virologie Wuhan. Das Institut beherbergt Chinas einziges Labor der Biosicherheitsstufe 4 (BSL-4) und wurde errichtet, um die gefährlichsten Krankheitserreger der Welt unter strengsten Sicherheitsvorkehrungen zu erforschen. Was jedoch in seinen Labors vor sich geht, bleibt der Außenwelt weitgehend verborgen. (Senderinfo).

programme.title: Roger
programme.desc: The lively adventures of a little girl, the carefree, joyful and occasionally perky Fatou, and an alien, the clumsy Roger, on a tropical island… Throughout their adventures, they trigger small accidents that sometimes grow into major disasters, but (almost) always end on a happy note. In short, Roger and Fatou spend their time saving the island from their own mistakes and blunders.

programme.title: Angry Birds Toons
programme.desc: Check out Angry Birds Toons compilations! Each compilation has several episodes from your favorite shows including Angry Birds, Piggy Tales, and Stella!

programme.title: Woodventures
programme.desc: "Woodventures" is an animated series for preschool children. The main characters are wooden toys: Kitty Meow, Doggy Woof-Woof, Piggy Oink, Horsey Yee-Ho-Ho and Elephant Pawoo. The toys live in a small wooden town (the prototype of a child's play room). Every toy has its own unique personality and reacts to different circumstances appropriately. With the help of the invisible narrator, the toys, along with the audience solve different tasks, play and take part in adventures. "Woodventures" is a musical series with lots of songs and dances. Some of the songs represent our characters and appear in each series, and some of the songs are related to the events in the series, so it is only found in that particular episode.Each episode presents a playful and learning environment.

programme.title: Cutie Cubies
programme.desc: An animation series about the adventures of four aliens - Cubies: Captain, Boatswain, Navigator, and Doctor. Having arrived on our planet and disguised as representatives of the local flora and fauna of the cubic form: a yellow chicken, a red rabbit, a blue aquarium and a bush of green grass, they are learning the diverse phenomena of our planet Earth.

programme.title: Ollie! The Boy Who Became What He Ate
programme.desc: Ollie is a 6-year-old with a massive imagination, often lost in his own world - flipping, sliding, climbing and rocket-blasting through the house, practicing at being the master of all things. But even masters need to stop and refuel. When meals or snack time interrupt Ollie’s play, he finds himself confronted with the real challenge of childhood; trying new food. To escape his predicament, Ollie uses his magic spoon to transport himself, along with his sister Poppy, and her stuffy Nummy, to a food planet filled with adventure and the very food Ollie stuck his spoon into.

programme.title: Heroes of Envell
programme.desc: Present days. Saint Petersburg. Four friends – Art, Kira, Phil and Vic are the coolest gamers in school. Eventually they find a suspicious laptop with «Heroes of Envell» game installed on it. Turns out that this very laptop is a portal to another dimension, a game realm which is full of adventures and real-life danger. The game realm is a blend of medieval, steampunk and futurism. You never know what really awaits our heroes. Just like the design of the game, the game logic is very unpredictable. You start with a quest and then it becomes a race right until it all grows into a tricky brainteaser. But be sure about one thing – there is no boring or easy way in here. programme.title: VIP Pets

programme.title: Back to Back
programme.desc: Embark on an electrifying journey as they boldly leap from one heart-pounding expedition to the next, fueled by their unbreakable bond and insatiable thirst for excitement. Get ready to be swept away in a whirlwind of adrenaline-pumping quests, where danger and discovery await them at every turn.

programme.title: Bat Pat
programme.desc: The series follows the comedy adventures of Bat Pat and the Silver brothers Martin, Leo and Rebecca as they unravel mysteries and cross paths with supernatural creatures of the night that lurk, haunt, shriek and dig themselves up in every dark corner of their home in Fogville, a small town that seems to be the center of all things weird in the world, a veritable magnet to ghosts, mummies, witches, creatures, werewolves and things that go bump in the night. Bat Pat will prove that the supernatural isn’t always evil but just misunderstood. Our heroes will come to understand something important: the supernatural “bad guys” are not really bad, but normal people whose actions are misunderstood by the more inhabitants of Fogville and what they really want is... just help!

programme.title: TOBOT
programme.desc: Ryan and Kory are twin brothers with one big secret: They’re Tobot pilots.

programme.title: Winx Club
programme.desc: Winx Club is a fantasy saga revolving around six fairies and their adventures. The protagonists Bloom, Stella, Flora, Aisha, Tecna and Musa live their daily life on Magix world, among lessons, loves, quarrels and moments of strong friendship. programme.title: Grojband
programme.desc: The story about 12 year old Corey that emotionally torments his sister so that she will write the ultimate lyrics for his garage band.

programme.title: Monsuno
programme.desc: The series revolves around re-awakened Monster DNA, called Monsuno, that finds its way into the unsuspecting hands of adventure-seeking teenagers Chase, Jinja, and Bren. Accompanied by their Monsuno, Lock, Charger, and Quickforce, they are searching for Chase's father Jeredy Suno, the creator of the Monsuno.

programme.title: Paper Tales
programme.desc: Animation series “Paper Tales” narrate to children audience in fascinating way amusing adventures of paper animals – a moose named Aristotle and a woodpecker named Knock-Knock – in paper land where everything is made only from paper. Merry adventures come together with entertaining insets “for crafty hands” when the audience learns how to produce all cartoon characters using paper, cardboard, scissors and glue. The project is supported with the site where all flat patterns are provided with the advices how to manufacture the paper world items.This is the way spectator gets involved into a peculiar game that brings out creative work and development of many useful practical skills, distracting kids from permanent attachment to a computer. The “Paper Tales” project is a fascinating and helpful alternative to computer-oriented pastime. The whole cartoon is accompanied by off-screen narrator’s text and exuberant flow of gags. Each episode is planned to last for 5 minutes (a version without insets – 4 minutes). Technique of performance is 3D computer graphics imitating paper application work.

programme.title: Magic Lantern
programme.desc: Animation series “Magic Lantern” tells little viewers wonderful adventure stories, based on classic literature plots. Little video games fan Mike and his smart sister Kate watch and discuss each story presented as a strip film. Funny stories will help seeing classic stories from the new side and prove that world classic literature is exciting and interesting.

programme.title: Pincode

In this episode, kids learn about molecular self assembly.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Marathon in the Florida Keys is home to some of the most unique fishing in the world, and on this episode of Local Knowledge we’re experiencing it with one of the area’s most respected captains. Rush Maltz reunites with his longtime friend, Captain Jeff Rella of Superfish Charters, to explore the deep drop fishery of the middle keys and Marathon. Together they target awesome species including queen snapper, barrel-fish, snowy grouper, and tilefish. After action-packed day offshore, we unwind at the world-famous Hawks Cay Resort, one of the Florida Keys’ premier destinations for anglers, families, and anyone looking to experience island life at its best.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: In this episode, Rush welcomes Cullen Lundholm from Cape Cod to experience Key West at its finest. Over several action-packed days, they target a variety of species in the incredible waters surrounding the Florida Keys. But the adventure doesn’t end at the dock—Cullen also experiences Key West’s world-class accommodations, exceptional food, and one-of-a-kind island lifestyle. From unforgettable fishing to first-class hospitality, this episode shows why Key West and the Florida Keys are among the world’s premier fishing and vacation destinations.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The Local Knowledge crew heads to Catalina Island off the coast of Southern California to participate in the 2024 War Heroes On Water tournament. This event offers a unique opportunity for the sport fishing community to create meaningful connections with our nation's heroes while raising awareness of the challenges they sometimes face when transitioning back to civilian life. With a little bit of luck and a lot of teamwork, Ali and Rush hope to put their veterans on a Bluefin tuna bite they won't forget!

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: Rush takes up an invite from good friend and fellow guide Jared Cyr to sight fish for barracuda and bonefish in the shallow waters of the Florida Keys. Meanwhile Rush's boat takes a break from charter fishing to get a new Seakeeper RIDE system installed.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: After a great trip fishing the flats, Rush returns the favor and extends an invite to friend Jarred Cyr fishing offshore. Fishing in Key West is all about the variety of species and opportunities they present. Mixing it up and taking advantage of this, the guys decide to see how many species they can catch using light spin and fly tackle offshore.

programme.title: Local Knowledge
programme.desc: The LK crew returns to Guatemala with more friends for our yearly dose of world class fishing! Year after year, Casa Vieja Lodge continues to impress with daily shots at sailfish, marlin, mahi, and tuna. Tag along on our 2nd annual group trip for a tropical fishing experience like no other!

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Season 4 of Hunting Land Man is starting off with a bang. In this episode, it’s opening week of turkey season in Mississippi, and these birds are doing it right. Cool mornings, gobbles breaking daylight, and longbeards fired up and on the move. We are fired up for the 2026 turkey season.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: In this episode Slade gets very busy in the real estate world. But lucky for him, Caleb Armstrong takes up the slack. Caleb sets out to hunt swamp bucks on the public land of Tensas Parish.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Episode 2 of Hunting Land Man keeps it rolling in the Mississippi woods. We’ve got some good buddies in camp this week, and it doesn’t take long for things to get interesting. One hunt ends in a tough miss, but we stay after it and bounce back with a longbeard hitting the dirt not long after. Later in the week, Slade’s wife Lori gets her first turkey of the year in an awesome hunt that came together just right. That’s just how it goes, what turkey hunting is all about, some ups, some downs, and a whole lot of good times. Season 4 is heating up.

programme.title: Hunting Land Man
programme.desc: Slade is staying busy busy around the house, lots of testing on summer plots with Deergro and Backwoods bachelor pad blend. programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Everything is bigger in Texas, including the stories. With the whitetail rut in the midwest winding down, the Winchester Life Crew of Chris Keefer, Casey Keefer, Nikki Boxler and Paul Sawyer head south to the Texas Panhandle with Winchesters in hand hoping to wrangle in a few Texas-sized giants.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: The positive impact made by the shooting sports and recreational shooting to people across our country can’t be measured in just one story, so we have three. In Florida, Olympian Dania Vizzi trains at her home shooting facility and talk about how she went from ballerina to one of the best shotgun shooters in the world. In Nebraska, firearms instructor Thea Van Syoc has used the disciplines of competitive pistol shooting and training to help shape her life. Finally we’ll take a look into the National African American Gun Association and learn how one day at the range for Phillip Smith created the fastest growing firearm organization in the United States.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: Nikki Boxler’s life in Update New York on her family farm raising cattle and producing maple syrup is a few thousand miles from the hills of New Mexico. We’ll take a look into Nikki’s life back home and then follow along as she visits the small town of Quemado and its bustling population of 228, while she pursues bugling elk with her favorite Winchester in hand. We’ll also head to Missouri and Texas to chase whitetails with Chris Keefer and Paul Sawyer.

programme.title: Winchester Life
programme.desc: We set out to tell the tale of Marion - and his legendary Mack’s Prairie Wings, smack dab in the middle of the world famous Stuttgart, Arkansas - the land of ducks and rice. Get an inside look at a man that many consider to be larger than life, from those that knew him best, like his cousin and fellow hell raiser, Bud McCollum. We’ll even hear a story or two from Milton Stovesand, an 81 year old former waterfowl guide and Mack’s employee who actually guided John Olin a time or two, and ran the timber holes with Marion. It’s timber holes and tall tales. It’s cups of coffee and cupped up wings. It’s partners in business, and partners in potholes and it’s pure Arkansas...just like Marion.

programme.desc: In this episode Andy and his friend Scotty take on Kodiak Island, Alaska for an adventure of Salmon fishing and hunting black tail deer. programme.desc: In this episode Andy goes back to his home farm in Alabama for deer and quail hunting.
